steps.title: Cabernet Sauvignon
steps.body: Cabernet Sauvignon is Napa's star, about 40% of vineyards and most of its value. Napa Cabernet is ripe and powerful, with blackcurrant, black cherry, cassis, chocolate and mint, ripe tannins and often 14.5% alcohol or more, aged in new French oak. Bordeaux-style blends are called Meritage, a trademarked term.

steps.title: Others
steps.body: Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot and Malbec join Cabernet in blends. Chardonnay is the main white, especially in cooler Carneros. Sauvignon Blanc, sometimes called Fumé Blanc, a name Mondavi coined, and Zinfandel also grow. Pinot Noir thrives in Carneros.
Napa Cabernet grapes are among the most expensive in the world, often over 10,000 dollars per tonne for top vineyards.
